events.quote: On facts, a Show Cause Notice was issued to the Petitioner on 23rd May, 2024 (hereinafter, ‘SCN’).
A reminder notice dated 22nd July, 2024 was also issued to the Petitioner and a personal hearing was fixed on 25 July, 2024.
However, no reply has been filed to the same nor any personal hearing has been attended by the Petitioner.
However, no reply has been filed to the same nor any personal hearing has been attended by the Petitioner.
Thereafter, the impugned order has been passed without the Petitioner having an opportunity to deal with the case on merits.

defects_argued.quote: However, in the present case, the objection with respect to the ‘Additional Notices Tab’ is not tenable as the SCN has been issued on 23rd May, 2024 and the impugned order has been passed on 2nd August, 2024, which are after 16th January, 2024.
The challenge in the present petition is similar to a batch of petitions wherein, inter alia, the impugned notifications were challenged.

outcome.quote: The impugned order is accordingly set aside, subject to payment of Rs. 15000/- as costs which goes to the Delhi High Court Clerks Association.
